morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic compound ([quality|feature](stem) + element: Dun-derg red-fort, Ard-mor great-height) layered over Maya place-compounds (-kah/-witz/-ha', Noh-, Chak-/Ek-): the capital Xochidon (the flower-fort, Xochi- + dun/don), Noh-Cathair (the great pyramid-city), the clans seated on the carved witz; Dun-/Rath- for the steadings.
morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling clans keep the Mac- (son of) / O-Ua (descendant of) patronymic and the fine/cland kin-name; the Maya populace keep the ch'ib'al (lineage) with aj- (he of) / ix- (she of) and the calendar-day name; the throne fuses both - a ri who also carries a ch'ib'al house-style. Renowned warriors take an earned deed- or animal-name (the Hound, the Jaguar).

patterns.dungeons_ruins: vine-choked pyramids and fallen Goidelic raths: 'the lost Witz of [ajaw]', 'the Sunken Cenote of [name]', 'the Howe of the [cland]'
patterns.military_units: the ri's war-host (the slua) and the warrior-societies: 'the Slua of Xochidon', 'the Hound-band of Orlann', 'the Jaguar Holkan'
patterns.ships: river-canoes and coastal war-galleys: 'the Jade Hound', 'Pride of the Abha', 'the Quetzal Prow'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]' and the balche'-court: 'The Bronze Cauldron', 'The Hound and Stela', 'the Cacao House'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic.json theonym_set.forms), Mayan variants SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.mayan), never real Celtic/Maya gods (no Lugh, Brigid, Dagda; no Itzamna, Kukulkan, Chaac, Kinich Ahau). Shared pantheon, two registers. Xochidon allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The Goidelic nemed (sacred grove) and the Maya witz (pyramid) are both altars; the Long-Count calendar and the bardic-druidic lore bind the ri to the powers.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as demons under Lawful or Neutral worship, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Maya Marakab the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Maya Wakix the Devourer); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Maya Lusankaan the Feathered Serpent). Under Chaotic worship the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods (Eternan the Tyrant-Sky, Toran the Cold-Sun).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the cattle-field beneath the green pyramid
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron sword crossed with the jaguar-pelt
holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-disc over the bardic-knotwork and the bloodletting-stela

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or the K'uh-nah (Maya god-house) atop the witz (pyramid) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified ri and clan-champions (the sinsear, honored at the howe and the carved pillar-stone) and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors (the uchben, honored at the pyramid-tomb and the glyph-stela).

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaian (Maya Kayanab) - the enduring earth, the maize-ground
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realtan (Maya Ix Rialtaj) - the mother, mercy
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Maya Tulax) - the sun and justice

religion.the_one: Eternan (Goidelic; Maya Aj Ternaj) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, chief among them Maragan the war-fire (Maya Marakab the City-Burner) and the feathered hoard-serpent Losand (Maya Lusankaan); the One (Eternan) and the Lawful powers are reviled as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the war-frenzy of the cattle-raid and the offered heart atop the witz are kindred rites
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan the One foremost, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers demons to be warded; the bardic law-lore and the Long-Count rite bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the sinsear of the ruling clans, the deified ri honored at the howe) and the city-powers of the k'uhul-kah and the uchben of the ch'ib'al, the powers of grove, peak and pyramid invoked situationally; the great powers petitioned at the nemed and the witz as need demands

titles._tiers_note: Goidelic clanhold ladder, ascending, with the Maya substrate co-titles beneath. Flaith (noble-lord) barony over a Flaithes; Flaith-criche (border-lord) march over a Crich (border); Toisech (clan-chief) county; Tigerna (lord of a domain) duchy; Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality over a Tuath (petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Ruirecht; Ard-ri (high king) empire over the Ard-rige (high-kingship). The conquered cities keep their Maya ajaw (lord) and sajal (governor) and the ah-k'in (sun-priest) beneath the Goidelic crown. The brithem (judge) and the fili/ollam (poet-sage) stand outside the ladder, as do the Maya glyph-scribes. Rank titles fuse the real Goidelic and Maya registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Goidelic war-aristocracy over the Maya temple-cities: the ard-ri and his flaith-kin at the crown, the ri-tuaithe over the k'uhul-kah cities, the cu-retainers (hound-champions) sworn to the war-host; the ah-k'in priesthood and the glyph-scribes of the ch'ib'al serve beneath)
titles.heir: Tanaiste (the chosen heir; the second after the ri)

honorifics.champion: Cu (the Hound; Goidelic champion) / Holkan (Maya warrior)

vassalage.fealty: Mionn (the oath) / Patan-t'an (Maya oath of service)
